name: Venusaur

abilities.name: overgrow
abilities.effect: Strengthens grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

genderDifference: Female's flower has a visible gynoecium

kanto.flavorText: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

original-johto.flavorText: As it warms it­ self and absorbs the sunlight, its flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.

hoenn.flavorText: VENUSAUR’s flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

updated-johto.flavorText: It is able to convert sunlight into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

original-unova.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

updated-unova.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

kalos.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: There is a large flower on Venusaur’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.

swsh.flavorText: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
